info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MSTR Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of MicroStrategy Inc. (NASDAQ: MSTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock. At the end of each trading day, the notional exposure against the underlying stock obtained through the combination of these instruments will be approximately 200% of the fund's net asset value. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MSTR Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 MicroStrategy Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MSTR）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入標的股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。在每個交易日結束時，透過這些工具的組合獲得的標的股票的名義曝險將約為基金資產淨值的200%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long MSTR ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of 2.00 (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of MSTR. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with financial institutions for a specified period, which may range from one day to longer than a year. The advisor has adopted a policy to have at least 80% exposure to financial instruments with economic characteristics that should perform 2X the daily performance of the underlying security's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long MSTR ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 MSTR 股價每日百分比變化的 2.00 (200%)。該基金將與金融機構簽訂一項或多項在指定期限內的掉期協議，期限可能從一天到一年以上。顧問已採取一項政策，要求至少 80% 的金融工具具有經濟特徵，其表現應是基礎證券股票每日表現的 2 倍。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Leveraged Long + Income MSTR ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by entering into derivatives transactions (i.e., swap agreements and options contracts) to gain long exposure to MicroStrategy Incorporated ("MSTR," or the "Underlying Security"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Leverged Long + Income MSTR ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過進行衍生性商品交易（即掉期協議和選擇權合約）以獲得 MicroStrategy Incorporated（「MSTR」或「基礎證券」）的長期風險來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 2x XRP ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of XRP. The fund is an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through managed exposure to XRP futures contracts that trade only on an exchange registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("XRP Futures Contracts"), and cash, cash-like instruments or high-quality securities that serve as collateral to the fund's investments in XRP Futures Contracts ("Collateral Investments"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 2x XRP ETF 尋求扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於 XRP 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金是一檔交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過管理 XRP 期貨合約（僅在商品期貨交易委員會註冊的交易所交易）（「XRP 期貨合約」）以及作為基金 XRP 期貨合約投資抵押品的現金、類現金工具或高品質證券（「抵押投資」）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TJGC Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of marketing and advertising services. It offers one-stop advertising services to clients throughout the entire advertising process, which comprises the planning, creating, launching, managing, and performance monitoring of the advertisements. The company was founded by Kai Kwan Lam, Chi Fung Lau, and Chun Pong Siu on May 13, 2022 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: TJGC Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，從事提供行銷和廣告服務。為客戶提供廣告規劃、創作、投放、管理、成效監控等整個廣告流程的一站式廣告服務。該公司由林啟君、劉志峰和俊邦蕭於2022年5月13日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: DeFi Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of investment services. It plans to acquire equity, debt, or other securities of publicly traded or private companies or other entities. The firm offers DeFi ETNs, DeFi Governance, DeFi Venture and DeFi Treasury. The company was founded by Olivier Francois Roussy Newton and Wouter Witvoet on April 14, 1986 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: DeFi Technologies, Inc.從事提供投資服務。它計劃收購上市公司或私人公司或其他實體的股權、債務或其他證券。該公司提供 DeFi ETN、DeFi 治理、DeFi Venture 和 DeFi Treasury。該公司由 Olivier Francois Roussy Newton 和 Wouter Witvoet 於 1986 年 4 月 14 日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Upexi, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of consumer products through direct-to-consumer network, wholesale partnerships, and major third-party platforms like Amazon. Its brands include LuckyTail, Prax, Cure Mushrooms, Moonwlkr, and Gumi Labs. The company was founded on September 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: Upexi, Inc. 透過直接面向消費者的網路、批發合作夥伴以及亞馬遜等主要第三方平台從事消費品的開發、製造和分銷。其品牌包括 LuckyTail、Prax、Cure Mushrooms、Moonwlkr 和 Gumi Labs。該公司成立於2018年9月5日，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: Direxion Daily COIN Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of COIN. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of COIN and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to COIN, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily COIN Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 COIN 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 COIN 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些組合起來提供 2 倍的每日 COIN 槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SuperX AI Technology Ltd. engages in providing artificial intelligence infrastructure solutions. It offers integrated systems that include computation, model hosting, data pipelines, and orchestration tools to facilitate enterprise AI deployment on a global scale. The company was founded on August 25, 2021, and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: SuperX AI Technology Ltd. 致力於提供人工智慧基礎設施解決方案。它提供包括運算、模型託管、資料管道和編排工具的整合系統，以促進全球範圍內的企業人工智慧部署。該公司成立於2021年8月25日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Tron, Inc. is an established toy and souvenir design company, which supplies theme parks and entertainment venues. The company operates through two core business segments: the design, manufacture, and sale of toys to premier theme parks, and a Digital Asset Treasury Strategy centered on TRX tokens. The company was founded on April 22, 2022 and is headquartered in Winter Park, FL.
info.description_zh: Tron, Inc. 是一家老牌玩具和紀念品設計公司，為主題樂園和娛樂場所提供產品。該公司透過兩個核心業務部門運營：設計、製造和向頂級主題公園銷售玩具，以及以 TRX 代幣為中心的數位資產財務策略。該公司成立於 2022 年 4 月 22 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州溫特帕克。

info.description: Canary HBAR ETF seeks to seek to provide exposure to the value of the fund held by the Trust, less the expenses of the Trust's operations. In seeking to achieve the investment objective, the Trust will hold the fund and will value its net assets and the Shares daily based on the Pricing Benchmark. HBAR will be the only digital asset held by the Trust. The Pricing Benchmark is a U.S. dollar-denominated composite reference rate for the price of the fund.
info.description_zh: Canary HBAR ETF 旨在尋求提供信託持有的基金價值減去信託營運費用的曝險。為了實現投資目標，信託將持有該基金，並根據定價基準每日對其淨資產和股份進行估值。 HBAR 將是該信託持有的唯一數位資產。定價基準是以美元計價的基金價格的綜合參考利率。

info.description: Global X Blockchain & Bitcoin Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing directly or indirectly in equity securities of U.S. and non-U.S. "Blockchain Companies" and in long positions in U.S. listed bitcoin futures contracts. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in Blockchain Companies and in long positions on U.S. listed Bitcoin Futures contracts. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 區塊鏈和比特幣策略 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過直接或間接投資於美國和非美國「區塊鏈公司」的股本證券以及美國上市的比特幣期貨合約的多頭部位來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於區塊鏈公司以及美國上市的比特幣期貨合約的多頭部位。它是非多元化的。

info.description: 21Shares Sui ETF is a passive investment fund designed to provide direct, regulated exposure to SUI, the native token of the Sui Network, by tracking its performance via a specific pricing benchmark. The strategy involves holding physical SUI tokens in institutional-grade custody and seeks to reflect additional rewards generated from staking a portion of the Trust's SUI holdings, net of expenses and liabilities.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Sui ETF 是一款被動投資基金，旨在透過特定定價基準追蹤其表現，為 Sui 網路的原生代幣 SUI 提供直接、受監管的投資。該策略涉及以機構級託管方式持有實體 SUI 代幣，並尋求反映透過質押信託的部分 SUI 持有量（扣除費用和負債）而產生的額外獎勵。

info.description: Actuate Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing therapeutics which target cancers and neurodegenerative diseases. It offers treatment for cancer and inflammatory diseases. It focuses on developing elraglusib. The company was founded by Andrew P. Mazar on January 16, 2015 and is headquartered in Fort Worth, TX.

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and XRP 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P XRP 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P XRP Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in XRP so that the total value of the XRP to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和 XRP 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在費用和支出之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P XRP 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權報酬表現，其中 S&P 500 指數權重為 75%，S&P XRP 指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約 75% 的資產投資於構成標準普爾 500 指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資 XRP，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險敞口的 XRP 總價值約佔該基金資產的 25%。

info.description: 21shares Polkadot ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that provides direct, physically backed exposure to DOT, the native cryptocurrency of the Polkadot network. The fund seeks to track the performance of its underlying digital asset by holding DOT in secure, institutional-grade cold storage, while uniquely incorporating a staking component to capture network rewards that may be used to offset fund expenses or contribute to the net asset value.
info.description_zh: 21shares Polkadot ETF 是一款被動管理的交易所交易基金，提供直接、實物支援的 DOT（Polkadot 網路的原生加密貨幣）曝險。該基金尋求透過將 DOT 保存在安全的機構級冷庫中來追蹤其基礎數位資產的表現，同時獨特地納入質押組件來獲取網路獎勵，這些獎勵可用於抵消基金費用或貢獻淨資產價值。

info.description: Cabaletta Bio, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of engineered T cell therapies for B cell-mediated autoimmune diseases. Its proprietary technology utilizes chimeric autoantibody receptor to selectively bind and eliminate B cells that produce disease-causing autoantibodies. The company was founded by Michael C. Milone, Steven Nichtberger, and Aimee Payne in April 2017 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Cabaletta Bio, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於發現和開發針對 B 細胞介導的自身免疫性疾病的工程 T 細胞療法。其專有技術可利用嵌合自體抗體受體選擇性結合並消除產生致病自體抗體的 B 細胞。該公司由 Michael C. Milone、Steven Nichtberger 和 Aimee Payne 於 2017 年 4 月創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州費城。

info.description: Marker Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of novel cell-based immunotherapies and peptide-based vaccines for the treatment of hematological malignancies and solid tumor indications. The company was founded on October 22, 1991 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Marker Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的免疫腫瘤公司，致力於新型細胞免疫療法和勝肽疫苗的開發和商業化，用於治療血液惡性腫瘤和實體瘤適應症。該公司成立於1991年10月22日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Canary Litecoin ETF seeks to track the performance of LTC, as measured by the CoinDesk Litecoin Price Index, adjusted for the Trust's expenses and other liabilities. In seeking to achieve its investment objective, the Trust will hold LTC and establish its net asset value ("NAV") on each business day by reference to the index. The index is calculated by applying a weighting algorithm to the price and trading volume data for the immediately preceding 24-hour period as of 4:00 p.m., New York time, derived from the selected digital asset trading platforms (the "Constituent Trading Platforms"). CoinDesk Indices, Inc.
info.description_zh: Canary Litecoin ETF 旨在追蹤 LTC 的表現，根據 CoinDesk Litecoin 價格指數衡量，並根據信託的費用和其他負債進行調整。為了實現其投資目標，信託將持有 LTC 並在每個工作日參考該指數來確定其資產淨值（「NAV」）。該指數的計算方法是對選定數位資產交易平台（「成分交易平台」）截至紐約時間下午 4:00 之前 24 小時內的價格和交易量數據應用加權演算法。 CoinDesk 指數公司

info.description: Plains GP Holdings LP owns and operates midstream energy infrastructure and provides logistics services primarily for crude oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas through its indirect investment in Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. The firm operates through the following segments: Transportation, Facilities and Supply and Logistics. The Transportation segment consists of fee-based activities associated with transporting crude oil and NGL on pipelines, gathering systems, trucks and barges. The Facilities segment consists of fee-based activities associated with providing storage, terminalling and throughput services primarily for crude oil, NGL and natural gas, as well as NGL fractionation and isomerization services and natural gas and condensate processing services. The Supply and Logistics segment consists of storage of inventory during contango market conditions and the seasonal storage of NGL, purchase of NGL from producers, refiners, processors and other marketers, extraction of NGL from gas processed at the facilities. The company was founded in July 2013 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Plains GP Holdings LP 擁有並經營中游能源基礎設施，並透過其對 Plains All American Pipeline, L.P. 的間接投資，主要為原油、液化天然氣和天然氣提供物流服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：運輸、設施、供應和物流。運輸部門包括與透過管道、收集系統、卡車和駁船運輸原油和液化天然氣相關的收費活動。設施部門包括與主要為原油、液化天然氣和天然氣提供儲存、終端和吞吐量服務相關的收費活動，以及液化天然氣分餾和異構化服務以及天然氣和凝析油加工服務。供應和物流部門包括在期貨溢價市場條件下儲存庫存以及液化天然氣的季節性儲存，從生產商、煉油商、加工商和其他營銷商購買液化天然氣，從設施加工的天然氣中提取液化天然氣。該公司成立於2013年7月，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: Compugen Ltd. engages in the research, development, and commercialization of therapeutic and diagnostic biomarker product candidates including proteins and monoclonal antibodies. It focuses on research and development on immuno-oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded by Eli Mintz, Simchon Faigler, and Amir Natan on February 10, 1993 and is headquartered in Holon, Israel.
info.description_zh: Compugen Ltd. 從事治療和診斷生物標記候選產品（包括蛋白質和單株抗體）的研究、開發和商業化。它專注於免疫腫瘤學和自體免疫疾病的研究和開發。該公司由 Eli Mintz、Simchon Faigler 和 Amir Natan 於 1993 年 2 月 10 日創立，總部位於以色列霍隆。

info.description: Plains All American Pipeline LP engages in the operation of midstream energy infrastructure and provides logistics services for crude oil, natural gas liquids, and natural gas. It operates through the following business segments: Crude Oil and Natural Gas Liquids. The Crude Oil segment includes its crude oil pipelines, crude oil storage and marine terminals, and related crude oil marketing activities. The Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) segment refers to NGL pipelines, NGL storage, natural gas processing and NGL fractionation facilities, and related NGL marketing activities. The company was founded by Greg L. Armstrong in 1981 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Plains All American Pipeline LP 從事中游能源基礎設施運營，並為原油、液化天然氣和天然氣提供物流服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：原油和液化天然氣。原油部門包括原油管道、原油儲存和海運碼頭以及相關的原油行銷活動。液化天然氣（NGL）部門是指液化天然氣管道、液化天然氣儲存、天然氣加工和液化天然氣分餾設施以及相關液化天然氣行銷活動。該公司由 Greg L. Armstrong 於 1981 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: BRBI BR Partners SA engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the finance segment. The company was founded by Ricardo Fleury Cavalcanti de Albuquerque Lacerda in 2009 and is headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
info.description_zh: BRBI BR Partners SA 從事提供銀行服務。它透過金融部門運作。該公司由 Ricardo Fleury Cavalcanti de Albuquerque Lacerda 於 2009 年創立，總部位於巴西聖保羅。

info.description: Funko, Inc. engages in designing, sourcing, and distributing licensed pop culture products. Its product lines include media and entertainment content, which refer to movies, TV shows, video games, music, and sports. It operates through the United States, Europe, and Other International geographic segments. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Everett, WA.
info.description_zh: Funko, Inc. 從事設計、採購和分銷授權流行文化產品。其產品線包括媒體和娛樂內容，包括電影、電視節目、電玩、音樂和體育。它透過美國、歐洲和其他國際地理區域開展業務。該公司成立於 1998 年，總部位於華盛頓州埃弗里特。

info.description: Nkarta, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of natural killer cell therapies for the treatment of cancer. The firm's product include NKX101, which is in Phase I clinical trials for the treatment of relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia or higher risk myelodysplastic syndromes, and NKX019, a pre-clinical product, which is based on the ability to treat various B cell malignancies by targeting the CD19 antigen found on these types of cancerous cells. The company was founded by Dario Campana in 2005 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.

info.description_zh: Nkarta, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於癌症治療的自然殺手細胞療法的發現、開發和商業化。該公司的產品包括NKX101和NKX019，NKX101處於I期臨床試驗中，用於治療復發/難治性急性髓性白血病或高風險骨髓增生異常綜合徵，NKX019是一種臨床前產品，其基於通過靶向這些類型的癌細胞上發現的CD19抗原來治療各種B細胞惡性腫瘤的能力。該公司由 Dario Campana 於 2005 年創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Bonk, Inc. is a wellness and dietary supplement company. It has developed Sure Shot, the first patented wellness product on Earth that lowers blood alcohol content by supporting its metabolism, while boosting clarity, energy, and overall mood. The company was founded by Brian S. John on October 24, 2018 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Bonk, Inc. 是一家健康和膳食補充劑公司。該公司開發了 Sure Shot，這是地球上第一個獲得專利的健康產品，透過支持新陳代謝來降低血液中的酒精含量，同時提高清晰度、能量和整體情緒。該公司由 Brian S. John 於 2018 年 10 月 24 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Definitive Healthcare Corp. engages in the provision of healthcare commercial intelligence. Its solution offers information on healthcare providers and their activities to help the customers optimize from product development to go-to-market planning, sales, and marketing execution. The company was founded by Jason Kranzt in February 2011 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Definitive Healthcare Corp. 從事提供醫療保健商業情報。其解決方案提供有關醫療保健提供者及其活動的信息，以幫助客戶優化從產品開發到上市規劃、銷售和行銷執行的整個過程。該公司由 Jason Kranzt 於 2011 年 2 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Solid Biosciences, Inc. is a life science company, which engages in the development of treatments for patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. It also focuses on developing treatments for neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Ilan Ganot, Andrey J. Zarur, Matthew Bennett Arnold, Annie Ganot, and Gilad David Hayeem in March 2013 and is headquartered in Charlestown, MA.
info.description_zh: Solid Biosciences, Inc.是一家生命科學公司，致力於開發杜氏肌肉營養不良症患者的治療方法。它還專注於開發神經肌肉和心臟病的治療方法。該公司由 Ilan Ganot、Andrey J. Zarur、Matthew Bennett Arnold、Annie Ganot 和 Gilad David Hayeem 於 2013 年 3 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州查爾斯敦。

info.description: IAC is a media and Internet company comprised of some of the world's most recognized brands and products, such as HomeAdvisor, Vimeo, About.com, Dictionary.com, The Daily Beast, Investopedia, and Match Group's online dating portfolio, which includes Match, OkCupid and Tinder. The company is headquartered in the Chelsea neighborhood of New York City and has business operations and satellite offices around the world. In December 2004, Expedia split from IAC as a separate publicly traded company. In December 2011, TripAdvisor spun out from Expedia. In August 2008, IAC split into five separate publicly traded companies. The four spun-off companies were HSN, Ticketmaster, Interval Leisure Group, and Tree.com. IAC's notable acquisitions include: - 2012: [The About Group](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/about-com) - 2011: [OkCupid](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/okcupid) - 2011: [Meetic](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/meetic) - 2006: [Connected Ventures](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/connectedventures), the parent company of [CollegeHumor](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/collegehumor) - 2005: [Ask Jeeves](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/ask-com) - 2004: [TripAdvisor](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/tripadvisor) - 2003: LendingTree and remaining interest in Ticketmaster, Expedia and Hotels.com. - 2002: [Expedia](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/expedia) - 1999: [Match.com](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/match-com) - 1998: [Citysearch](http://www.crunchbase.com/organization/citysearch)

info.description: Taylor Devices, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and marketing of shock absorption, rate control, and energy storage devices. Its products include metal bellows dampers, fluid viscous dampers, landing and arresting gear, pumpkin mounts, isolation systems, custom applications, crane buffers, shock absorbers, liquid die springs, lock up devices, machined springs, and actuators. The company was founded by Paul H. Taylor on July 22, 1955 and is headquartered in North Tonawanda, NY.
info.description_zh: Taylor Devices, Inc. 從事減震、速率控制和儲能設備的設計、開發、製造和行銷。其產品包括金屬波紋管阻尼器、流體黏性阻尼器、著陸和煞車裝置、南瓜支架、隔離系統、客製化應用、起重機緩衝器、避震器、液體模具彈簧、鎖定裝置、機械加工彈簧和執行器。該公司由 Paul H. Taylor 於 1955 年 7 月 22 日創立，總部位於紐約州北托納旺達。

info.description: Invesco Agriculture Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to commodities drawn from the agriculture sector. It will not invest directly in physical commodities, Commodities Futures or Commodity-Linked Instruments. Instead, The Advisor attempts to obtain investment returns that are highly correlated to the agriculture commodities markets by investing in these instruments indirectly through its Subsidiary. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順農業商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過投資與農業部門商品經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。它不會直接投資於實體商品、商品期貨或商品相關工具。相反，顧問試圖透過其子公司間接投資於這些工具，以獲得與農產品市場高度相關的投資回報。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long GEMI Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of GEMI. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GEMI, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Gemini Space Station, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in building secure financial infrastructure for the next generation of money and markets, providing access for individuals and institutions to a financial future that is more open, fair, and secure. The company was founded by Tyler Winklevoss and Cameron Winklevoss in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Synopsys, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design automation (EDA) software that engineers use to design and test integrated circuits (ICs). It also offers semiconductor intellectual property (IP) products. It operates through the Design Automation and Design IP segments. The Design Automation segment includes silicon design, verification of products and services, and Ansys products, and system integration of products and services. The Design IP segment refers to interface, foundation, security, and embedded processor IP, IP subsystems, and IP implementation services that serve companies primarily in the semiconductor and electronics industries. The company was founded by Aart J. de Geus, Bill Krieger, Dave Gregory, and Rick Rudell in December 1986 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.

info.description: BlackLine, Inc. engages in providing a cloud-based software platform that automates and controls financial close and accounting processes. info.description_zh: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. 從事社群媒體營運和技術業務。其品牌包括 TRUTH Social、TMTG+ 和 TMTG News。它透過 Media 和 Truth.Fi 部門運作。媒體部門包括產品和服務，例如透過 Truth Social 平台進行廣告。 Truth.Fi 部門涉及投資於美國優先原則的客製化交易所交易基金或交易所交易產品，以及比特幣和類似的加密貨幣或加密相關證券。該公司成立於2024年3月28日，總部位於佛羅裡達州薩拉索塔。

info.description: Emmis Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. info.description: First Trust Germany AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Germany Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Germany Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 德國 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 德國指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克德國指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: T Stamp, Inc. engages in development of proprietary artificial intelligence-powered solutions. It also focuses on researching and leveraging machine learning artificial intelligence, including computer vision, cryptography, and data mining, to process and protect data for identification against fraud. The company was founded by Gareth Genner, Andrew Gowasack, Catherine Lambert and Mike Lindenau on November 9, 2015 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: T Stamp, Inc. 致力於開發專有的人工智慧驅動解決方案。它還專注於研究和利用機器學習人工智慧，包括電腦視覺、密碼學和資料探勘，來處理和保護資料以防止詐欺。該公司由 Gareth Genner、Andrew Gowasack、Catherine Lambert 和 Mike Lindenau 於 2015 年 11 月 9 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Intrusion, Inc. is a cybersecurity company, which offers customers access to its exclusive threat intelligence database containing the historical data, known associations, and reputational behavior of Internet Protocol addresses. Its solutions include INTRUSION Shield, INTRUSION TraceCop, and INTRUSION Savant. The company was founded by T. Joe Head and G. Ward Paxton in September 1983 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Intrusion, Inc. 是一家網路安全公司，為客戶提供存取其獨家威脅情報資料庫的權限，其中包含網際網路協定位址的歷史資料、已知關聯和聲譽行為。其解決方案包括 INTRUSION Shield、INTRUSION TraceCop 和 INTRUSION Savant。該公司由 T. Joe Head 和 G. Ward Paxton 於 1983 年 9 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: JPMorgan Managed Futures Plus ETF combines a strategic, long-term large-capitalization U.S. equity exposure with a systematic, model-driven managed futures strategy that takes long and short positions globally across equities, fixed income, currencies, and commodities. The fund implements its multi-asset framework via direct stock investments and substantial derivative exposures, while managing a portion of its commodity risk through a wholly owned Cayman Islands subsidiary.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通管理期貨Plus ETF將戰略性長期大盤美國股票敞口與系統化、模型驅動的管理期貨策略相結合，該策略在全球範圍內持有股票、固定收益、貨幣和大宗商品的多頭和空頭頭寸。該基金透過直接股票投資和大量衍生性商品曝險實施其多元資產框架，同時透過全資擁有的開曼群島子公司管理部分商品風險。

info.description: Materialise NV engages in the provision of additive manufacturing software and 3D printing services. It operates through the following segments: Materialise Software, Materialise Medical, and Materialise Manufacturing. The Materialise Software segment offers proprietary software worldwide through programs and platforms that enable companies to set up reliable and sustainable 3D printing production. The Materialise Medical segment includes medical software solutions, medical devices and other related products and services. The Materialise Manufacturing segment provides 3D printed services to industrial and commercial customers. The company was founded by Wilfried Vancraen and Hilde Ingelaere on June 28, 1990 and is headquartered in Leuven, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Materialise NV 從事提供積層製造軟體和 3D 列印服務。它透過以下部門運作：Materialize Software、Materialise Medical 和 Materialise Manufacturing。 Materialise Software 部門透過程式和平台在全球範圍內提供專有軟體，使公司能夠建立可靠且可持續的 3D 列印生產。 Materialise Medical 部門包括醫療軟體解決方案、醫療設備以及其他相關產品和服務。 Materialise Manufacturing 部門為工業和商業客戶提供 3D 列印服務。該公司由 Wilfried Vancraen 和 Hilde Ingelaere 於 1990 年 6 月 28 日創立，總部位於比利時魯汶。

info.description: Okta, Inc. engages in the provision of an identity management platform for enterprises. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: United States and International. Its products include single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, access gateway, API access management, authentication, adaptive MFA and lifecycle management. The company was founded by Todd McKinnon and J. Frederic Kerrest in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

info.description: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PANW. info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PANW 每日業績的 200% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PANW 證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 PANW 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PANW Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PANW. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PANW 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PANW 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 PANW 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與該基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ScanSource, Inc. engages in the development and provision of technology products and services. It operates through the Specialty Technology Solutions and Intelisys & Advisory segments. The Specialty Technology Solutions segment includes enterprise mobile computing, data capture, barcode printing, POS, payments, networking, electronic physical security, cybersecurity and other technologies. The Intelisys & Advisory segment refers to the United States and consists of sales and services to both channel sales partners (Intelisys) and end users (Advisory). The company was founded by Michael L. Baur and Steven H. Owings in December 1992 and is headquartered in Greenville, SC.
info.description_zh: ScanSource, Inc. 從事技術產品和服務的開發和提供。它透過專業技術解決方案和 Intelisys 與諮詢部門運作。專業技術解決方案部門包括企業行動運算、資料收集、條碼列印、POS、支付、網路、電子實體安全、網路安全和其他技術。 Intelisys 和諮詢部門涉及美國，包括向通路銷售合作夥伴 (Intelisys) 和最終用戶 (Advisory) 提供的銷售和服務。該公司由 Michael L. Baur 和 Steven H. Owings 於 1992 年 12 月創立，總部位於南卡羅來納州格林維爾。

info.description: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Cybersecurity seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq CTA Cybersecurity IndexSM. The index is a modified liquidity weighted index comprised of companies classified as "cybersecurity" companies by CTA. The Advisor expects that its cash balances maintained in connection with the use of financial instruments will typically be held in money market instruments. It invests in common stock issued by public companies. The fund invests in derivatives, which are financial instruments whose value is derived from the value of an underlying asset or assets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Cyber​​security 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於納斯達克 CTA 網路安全指數 SM 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該指數是修改後的流動性加權指數，由 CTA 歸類為「網路安全」公司的公司組成。顧問預計其與使用金融工具相關的現金餘額通常以貨幣市場工具持有。它投資於上市公司發行的普通股。該基金投資於衍生性商品，這些衍生性商品是其價值源自標的資產或資產的價值的金融工具。該基金是非多元化的。

It is involved in utilizing technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and smart inventory management systems for shopping experience of customers. The company was founded by Shahan Ohanessian and Shoushana Ohanessian on January 31, 2023 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: VenHub Global, Inc. 從事全自動和機器人操作的便利商店的管理。它利用人工智慧（AI）和智慧庫存管理系統等技術來提升顧客的購物體驗。該公司由 Shahan Ohanessian 和 Shoushana Ohanessian 於 2023 年 1 月 31 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Vanguard Core-Plus Bond ETF seeks to provide total return while generating a moderate to high level of current income. The fund invests in fixed income securities of various maturities, yields, and qualities. info.description_zh: VictoryShares Core Intermediate Bond ETF 追求高当期收入，且不对本金造成不当风险。一般情况下，基金至少80%的资产投资于债务证券以及具有与此类证券类似经济特征的衍生品和其他工具。該基金最多可將其淨資產的20%投資於外債證券，包括非美元計價的證券和新興市場國家（即處於工業週期早期階段的國家）公司的證券。

info.description: Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Float Adjusted Index. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and at least 80% of its assets will be invested in bonds held in the index.

info.description: Galectin Therapeutics, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in drug research and development to create new therapies for fibrotic disease, severe skin disease, and cancer. Its programs target the development of carbohydrate molecules which offers alternative options to larger market segments. The company was founded by James C. Czirr and Anatole A. Klyosov on July 10, 2000 and is headquartered in Norcross, GA.
info.description_zh: Galectin Therapeutics, Inc.是一家生物技術公司，致力於藥物研發，為纖維化疾病、嚴重皮膚病和癌症創造新療法。其計劃的目標是開發碳水化合物分子，為更大的細分市場提供替代選擇。該公司由 James C. Czirr 和 Anatole A. Klyosov 於 2000 年 7 月 10 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州諾克羅斯。

info.description: Invesco Equal Weight 0-30 Year Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the ICE 1-30 Year Laddered Maturity U.S. Treasury Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the components of the index. The index provider compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is designed to track the performance of up to 30 U.S. Treasury Notes or Bonds representing the annual February maturity ladder across the yield curve.
info.description_zh: Invesco 等權重 0-30 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 1-30 年階梯式到期美國國債指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金一般會將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的成分股。指數提供者編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數旨在追蹤最多 30 種美國國債或債券的表現，代表每年 2 月殖利率曲線上的到期階梯。

info.description: Vanguard Long-Term Treasury Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a market-weighted Treasury index with a long-term dollar-weighted average maturity. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg U.S. Long Treasury Index. This index includes fixed income securities issued by the U.S. Treasury (not including inflation-protected bonds, floating rate securities and certain other security types), with maturities greater than 10 years. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard長期公債指數基金ETF份額旨在追蹤具有長期美元加權平均期限的市場加權國債指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博美國長期國債指數的表現。該指數包括美國財政部發行的期限超過 10 年的固定收益證券（不包括通膨保值債券、浮動利率證券和某些其他證券類型）。一般情況下，基金資產至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。

info.description: Avos Global Equities ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of global equity securities, including common and preferred stocks, depositary receipts, REITs, and underlying ETFs. The investment strategy utilizes a proprietary multi-step process that evaluates countries and companies based on long-term structural valuations and short-term market dynamics, ensuring exposure to at least three countries with a significant allocation to non-U.S. developed and emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Avos 全球股票 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於全球股票證券的多元化投資組合（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證、房地產投資信託基金和基礎 ETF）來實現長期資本增值。此投資策略採用專有的多步驟流程，根據長期結構性估值和短期市場動態對國家和公司進行評估，確保投資於至少三個國家，並在非美國已開發市場和新興市場上有大量配置。

info.description: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 20+ Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that the advisor believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity greater than or equal to twenty years.
info.description_zh: iShares 20+ 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 20+ 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於顧問認為將有助於基金追蹤標的指數的美國國債。基礎指數衡量剩餘期限大於或等於二十年的美國財政部公共債務的履行。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST MU ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Micron Technology, Inc. (MU). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.

info.description: Keurig Dr Pepper, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sales of non-alcoholic beverages. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Refreshment Beverages, U.S. Coffee, and International. The U.S. Refreshment Beverages segment manufactures and distributes beverage concentrates, syrups, and finished beverages including the brands Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, Snapple, A&W, 7UP, Sunkist soda, Squirt, Hawaiian Punch, Core Hydration, Bai, C4 Energy, Clamato, Evian, Yoo-Hoo, Big Red, and Vita Coco. The U.S. Coffee segment involves single serve brewers, specialty, hot and iced varieties, and ready-to-drink beverages. The International segment includes sales in Canada, Mexico, and other markets. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Frisco, TX.
info.description_zh: Keurig Dr Pepper, Inc. 從事非酒精飲料的製造、行銷、分銷和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：美國清涼飲料部門、美國咖啡部門和國際部門。美國清涼飲料部門生產和分銷濃縮飲料、糖漿和成品飲料，包括 Dr Pepper、Canada Dry、Mott's、Snapple、A&W、7UP、Sunkist 蘇打水、Squirt、Hawaiian Punch、Core Hydration、Bai、C4 Energy、Clamato、Evian、Yoo-Hoo、Big Red 和 Cococo 等品牌。美國咖啡部門涉及單杯咖啡、特色咖啡、熱飲和冰飲以及即飲飲料。國際部門包括加拿大、墨西哥和其他市場的銷售。該公司成立於 2018 年，總部位於德克薩斯州弗里斯科。

info.description: Corteva, Inc. is a global pure-play agriculture company that combines innovative technologies, high-touch customer engagement and operational execution to profitably deliver solutions for the world's most pressing agriculture challenges. It generates advantaged market preference through its unique distribution strategy, together with its balanced and globally diverse mix of seed, crop protection, and digital products and services. The company leverages recognized agricultural brands and a robust technology pipeline to maximize productivity for farmers while working with stakeholders throughout the food system to fulfill its promise of enriching the lives of those who produce and those who consume, ensuring progress for generations to come. Corteva was founded in 1802 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.

info.description: TG Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the acquisition, development, and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell malignancies and autoimmune diseases. Its product pipeline includes TG-1501, TG-1701, Ublituximab, and Umbralisib. The company was founded by Michael Sean Weiss and Laurence H. Shaw on May 18, 1993 and is headquartered in Morrisville, NC.
info.description_zh: TG Therapeutics, Inc. 從事 B 細胞惡性腫瘤和自體免疫疾病新型療法的收購、開發和商業化。其產品管線包括TG-1501、TG-1701、Ublituximab和Umbralisib。該公司由 Michael Sean Weiss 和 Laurence H. Shaw 於 1993 年 5 月 18 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州莫里斯維爾。

info.description: Suja Life, Inc. is a modern beverage platform at the forefront of the functional, better-for-you beverage revolution. The company is on a mission to change what beverages bring to the table by delivering delicious, nutritious products that support healthier daily rituals for consumers nationwide. Suja Life offers a portfolio of trusted brands, including Suja Organic, Vive Organic, and Slice, with organic cold-pressed juices and wellness shots enjoyed nationwide. It operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer, utilizing organic, non-GMO, and plant-based ingredients to create beverages that deliver superior taste and functional wellness benefits without compromise. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Oceanside, CA.

info.description_zh: Suja Life, Inc. 是一個現代飲料平台，處於功能性、有益健康飲料革命的前沿。該公司的使命是透過提供美味、營養的產品來改變餐桌上的飲料，並支持全國消費者更健康的日常習慣。 Suja Life 提供一系列值得信賴的品牌，包括 Suja Organic、Vive Organic 和 Slice，以及全國享有盛譽的有機冷壓果汁和健康飲品。它作為一家垂直一體化製造商運營，利用有機、非基因改造和植物成分生產飲料，在不妥協的情況下提供卓越的口味和功能性健康益處。該公司成立於 2012 年，總部位於加州歐申賽德。

info.description: Imperial Petroleum, Inc. is a ship-owning company, which engages in the provision of petroleum products and crude oil seaborne transportation services. It offers international seaborne transportation services to oil producers, refineries, and commodities traders. The company has a fleet of three medium range product tankers that carry refined petroleum products, such as gasoline, diesel, fuel oil and jet fuel, as well as edible oils and chemicals, and one Aframax tanker, which is used for carrying crude oil. Imperial Petroleum was founded on May 14, 2021 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
info.description_zh: Imperial Petroleum, Inc.是一家船舶公司，從事提供石油產品和原油海運服務。它為石油生產商、煉油廠和大宗商品貿易商提供國際海運服務。該公司擁有一支由三艘中程成品油輪組成的船隊，運載汽油、柴油、燃料油和噴射燃料等精煉石油產品，以及食用油和化學品，以及一艘用於運載原油的阿芙拉型油輪。帝國石油成立於2021年5月14日，總部位於希臘雅典。

info.description: XP, Inc. engages in the operation of technology-driven financial services platform. The firm provides customers with two principal types of offerings, financial advisory services for retail clients in Brazil, high-net-worth clients, international clients and corporate and institutional clients, and an open financial product platform providing access to over 800 investment products including equity and fixed income securities, mutual and hedge funds, structured products, life insurance, pension plans, real-estate investment funds (REITs) and others from XP, its partners and competitors. he company was founded by Guilherme Dias Fernandes Benchimol in 2001 and is headquartered in Vila Olimpia, Brazil.

Its portfolio includes internal product candidates that are directed to oncology applications. The company was founded by Gregory Winter, John Tite, and Christian Heinis in 2009 and is headquartered in Cambridge, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Bicycle Therapeutics Plc 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發一類新型藥物，該公司稱之為“自行車”，用於治療現有療法治療不足的疾病。其產品組合包括針對腫瘤學應用的內部候選產品。該公司由 Gregory Winter、John Tite 和 Christian Heinis 於 2009 年創立，總部位於英國劍橋。

info.description: Rivian Automotive, Inc. engages in the design, development, and manufacture of category-defining electric vehicles and accessories. info.description_zh: Rivian Automotive, Inc. 從事定義類別的電動車及配件的設計、開發和製造。它透過以下部門運作：汽車部門、軟體部門和服務部門。該公司由 Robert J. Scaringe 於 2009 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long CRML Daily ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the daily performance of the common stock of Critical Metals Corp. (CRML). The fund is designed as a short-term trading tool for sophisticated investors seeking amplified bullish exposure to a specific mineral mining asset, utilizing financial derivatives to achieve its daily leverage target.

info.description: SNDL, Inc. is a licensed producer that crafts small-batch cannabis using state-of-the-art indoor facilities. It operates through the following segments: Liquor Retail, Cannabis Retail, Cannabis Operations, and Investments. The Liquor Retail segment consists of wines, beers, and spirits through owned liquor stores. The Cannabis Retail segment comprises of the private sale of adult-use cannabis through owned and franchise retail cannabis stores. The Cannabis Operations covers the cultivation, distribution and sale of cannabis for the adult-use, and medical markets domestically and for export. The Investments segment includes the deployment of capital to investment opportunities. The company was founded by Stanley J. Swiatek on August 19, 2006 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

info.description_zh: SNDL, Inc. 是一家獲得許可的生產商，使用最先進的室內設施生產小批量大麻。它透過以下部門運作：酒類零售、大麻零售、大麻營運和投資。酒類零售部門透過自有酒類商店銷售葡萄酒、啤酒和烈酒。大麻零售部門包括透過自營和特許零售大麻商店私人銷售成人用大麻。大麻業務涵蓋供成人使用以及國內和出口醫療市場使用的大麻的種植、分銷和銷售。投資部門包括將資本部署到投資機會。該公司由Stanley J. Swiatek於2006年8月19日創立，總部位於加拿大卡加利。

info.description: First Trust Alternative Absolute Return Strategy ETF seeks to provide investors with long-term total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve long-term total return through long and short investments in exchange-traded commodity futures contracts ("Commodity Futures") through a wholly-owned subsidiary of the fund organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands (the "Subsidiary"). It does not invest directly in Commodity Futures. The advisor gains exposure to these investments exclusively by investing in the Subsidiary. The Subsidiary is advised by First Trust Advisors L.P., the fund's investment advisor.
info.description_zh: First Trust Alternative絕對回報策略ETF旨在為投資者提供長期總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過該基金根據開曼群島法律組成的全資子公司（「子公司」）對交易所交易商品期貨合約（「商品期貨」）進行多頭和空頭投資，以實現長期總回報。它不會直接投資於商品期貨。顧問僅透過投資子公司來獲得這些投資的機會。該子公司由該基金的投資顧問 First Trust Advisors L.P. 提供諮詢服務。

info.description: Prime Medicine, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in developing one-time curative genetic therapies. The company was founded by David R. Liu on September 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Prime Medicine, Inc. 是一家生技公司，致力於開發一次性治療性基因療法。該公司由 David R. Liu 於 2019 年 9 月 13 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Sphere 3D Corp. is a bitcoin mining company. The firm is engaged in growing its digital asset mining operation through the capital-efficient procurement of next-generation mining equipment and partnering with data center operators. Its bitcoin mining business segment involves acquiring computer servers, which operate application-specific integrated circuit chips designed specifically to mine bitcoin, and deploy, such miners at-scale utilizing its hosting agreements. The company was founded on May 2, 2007 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Sphere 3D Corp. 是一家比特幣挖礦公司。該公司致力於透過資本高效的下一代採礦設備採購以及與資料中心營運商合作來發展其數位資產採礦業務。其比特幣挖礦業務部門涉及收購電腦伺服器，這些伺服器運行專門為挖掘比特幣而設計的專用集成電路晶片，並利用其託管協議大規模部署此類礦機。該公司成立於2007年5月2日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: enGene Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in developing gene therapies. It is developing non-viral gene therapies based on its novel and proprietary dually derived chitosan, or DDX, gene delivery platform, which allows localized delivery of multiple gene cargos directly to mucosal tissues and other organs. The company was founded by Anthony T. Cheung on April 24, 2023 and is headquartered in Saint-Laurent, Canada.
info.description_zh: enGene Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發基因療法。該公司正在開發基於其新穎且專有的雙衍生殼聚醣（DDX）基因遞送平台的非病毒基因療法，該平台允許將多種基因貨物直接局部遞送至黏膜組織和其他器官。該公司由 Anthony T. Cheung 於 2023 年 4 月 24 日創立，總部位於加拿大聖洛朗。

info.description: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Real Estate, Residential Real Estate, Commercial and Industrial, and Consumer. The Commercial Estate segment is involved in construction, non-residential, and multi-family. The Residential Real Estate Segment focuses on borrower's residential real estate generally in a first lien position. The Commercial and Industrial segment includes loans made for purposes of financing the activities of commercial customers. The Consumer segment engages in indirect automobile loans, home equity loans, and other consumer loans. The company was founded on August 30, 2018 and is headquartered in Poughkeepsie, NY.
info.description_zh: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. 作為一家銀行控股公司運營，提供銀行服務。它透過以下部門運作：商業房地產、住宅房地產、商業和工業以及消費者。商業地產部門涉及建築、非住宅和多戶住宅。住宅房地產部分主要關注借款人的住宅房地產，通常處於第一留置權位置。商業和工業部門包括為商業客戶活動融資而發放的貸款。消費者部門從事間接汽車貸款、房屋淨值貸款和其他消費貸款。該公司成立於2018年8月30日，總部位於紐約州波基普西。

info.description: Tesla, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems. It operates through the Automotive and Energy Generation and Storage segments. The Automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacture, sale, and lease of electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. The Energy Generation and Storage segment is involved in the design, manufacture, installation, sale, and lease of solar energy generation, energy storage products, and related services and sales of solar energy systems incentives. The company was founded by Jeffrey B. Straubel, Elon Reeve Musk, Martin Eberhard, and Marc Tarpenning on July 1, 2003 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Tesla, Inc. 從事電動車以及能源產生和儲存系統的設計、開發、製造和銷售。它透過汽車、能源生產和儲存部門運作。汽車部門包括電動車的設計、開發、製造、銷售和租賃以及汽車監管積分的銷售。能源發電和儲存部門從事太陽能發電、儲能產品的設計、製造、安裝、銷售和租賃，以及太陽能係統激勵措施的相關服務和銷售。該公司由 Jeffrey B. Straubel、Elon Reeve Musk、Martin Eberhard 和 Marc Tarpenning 於 2003 年 7 月 1 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Kyivstar Group Ltd. engages in the telecommunications and digital business. It provides mobile, digital and fixed-line services. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

info.description: GraniteShares 1.25x Long Tsla Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.25 times (125%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Tesla Inc. The fund is an actively managed etf that attempts to replicate 1.25 times (125%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. It is non-diversified.

info.description: Methanex Corp. engages in the production and supply of methanol. The firm supplies in the international markets such as North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, and South America. It also operates the methanol ocean tanker fleet. The company was founded on March 11, 1968 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Macetex Corp. 從事甲醇的生產和供應。該公司向北美、亞太地區、歐洲和南美等國際市場供貨。它還經營甲醇遠洋油輪船隊。該公司成立於1968年3月11日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of beverages, food, and snacks. It operates through the following business segments: PepsiCo Foods North America (PFNA), PepsiCo Beverages North America (PBNA), International Beverages Franchise (IB Franchise), Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA), Latin America Foods (LatAm Foods), and Asia Pacific Foods. The PFNA segment refers to the food businesses in the United States and Canada. The PBNA segment includes beverage businesses in the United States and Canada. The IB Franchise segment involves the international franchise beverage businesses, as well as the SodaStream business. The EMEA segment pertains to food businesses and beverage businesses with company-owned bottlers in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The LatAm Foods segment consists of food businesses in Latin America. The Asia Pacific Foods segment is associated in food businesses in Asia Pacific, including China, Australia and New Zealand, as well as India. The company was founded by Donald M. info.description: Deere & Co. engages in the manufacture and distribution of equipment used in agriculture, construction, forestry, and turf care. info.description: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of gene therapy treatment options for rare and devastating pediatric diseases. The firm's multi-platform development approach applies the lentiviral vector and adeno-associated viral vector gene therapy platforms. Its clinical program is an LVV-based gene therapy for the treatment of Fanconi Anemia (FA), a difficult to treat genetic disease that leads to bone marrow failure and potentially cancer. The company was founded on July 7, 1999 and is headquartered in Cranbury, NJ.
info.description_zh: Rocket Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物技術公司，致力於開發針對罕見和毀滅性兒科疾病的基因療法。該公司的多平台開發方法應用了慢病毒載體和腺相關病毒載體基因治療平台。其臨床計畫是基於 LVV 的基因療法，用於治療範可尼貧血 (FA)，這是一種難以治療的遺傳性疾病，會導致骨髓衰竭和潛在的癌症。該公司成立於1999年7月7日，總部位於新澤西州克蘭伯里。

info.description: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical stage bio-pharmaceutical company, which engages in the research, development, and commercialization of therapeutic drugs. The company was founded by Robert Foster, Richard Glickman, and Michael Martin on June 16, 1993 and is headquartered in Edmonton, Canada.
info.description_zh: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，從事治療藥物的研究、開發和商業化。該公司由 Robert Foster、Richard Glickman 和 Michael Martin 於 1993 年 6 月 16 日創立，總部位於加拿大埃德蒙頓。

info.description: WEBTOON Entertainment, Inc. engages in the provision of a global storytelling platform. The firm allows creators and users to discover, create, and share new content. Its brands include Munpia, Yonder, Studio Lico, LINE, and Creator Studios. The company was founded by Jun-Koo Kim in 2005 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: WEBTOON Entertainment, Inc. 致力於提供全球說故事平台。該公司允許創作者和用戶發現、創建和分享新內容。旗下品牌包括 Munpia、Yonder、Studio Lico、LINE 和 Creator Studios。該公司由 Jun-Koo Kim 於 2005 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: UP Fintech Holding Ltd. is an online brokerage firm that focuses on global investors. It provides an online trading platform that enables investors to trade in equities and other financial instruments on multiple exchanges around the world. The firm offers products and services, as well as a user experience to customers through its mobile first strategy. The company was founded by Tian Hua Wu in June 2014 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: UP Fintech Holding Ltd.是一家專注於全球投資者的線上經紀公司。它提供了一個線上交易平台，使投資者能夠在世界各地的多個交易所進行股票和其他金融工具的交易。該公司透過其行動優先策略為客戶提供產品和服務以及用戶體驗。該公司由吳天華於2014年6月創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: FirstCash Holdings, Inc. operates retail pawn stores in the United States and Latin America. Its pawn stores lend money on the collateral of pledged personal property, including jewelry, electronics, tools, appliances, sporting goods, and musical instruments, and retails merchandise acquired through collateral forfeitures on forfeited pawn loans and over-the-counter purchases of merchandise directly from customers. The firm is also involved in melting scrap jewelry, as well as selling gold, silver, and diamonds in commodity markets. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas.

info.description: VanEck Avalanche ETF is a passive grantor trust that provides direct exposure to the price of AVAX, the native cryptocurrency of the Avalanche blockchain, while also capturing staking rewards. The strategy involves holding spot AVAX and delegating a portion to validators to earn yield, which is accrued to the fund's net asset value rather than distributed as income.
info.description_zh: VanEck Avalanche ETF 是一種被動授予人信託，可直接接觸 Avalanche 區塊鏈的原生加密貨幣 AVAX 的價格，同時還可以獲得質押獎勵。該策略包括持有現貨 AVAX 並將一部分委託給驗證者以賺取收益，該收益將計入基金的資產淨值，而不是作為收入分配。

info.description: Grayscale Avalanche Staking ETF is a physically-backed exchange-traded product designed to provide passive exposure to the market price of AVAX, the native token of the Avalanche network, by holding the digital asset directly. The strategy distinguishes itself by incorporating a staking component, whereby the fund participates in the network's Proof of Stake consensus mechanism to earn rewards, which are then reflected in the value of the shares alongside the underlying asset's price performance.
info.description_zh: Grayscale Avalanche Stake ETF 是一種實體支援的交易所交易產品，旨在透過直接持有數位資產，提供對 Avalanche 網路原生代幣 AVAX 市場價格的被動敞口。該策略的獨特之處在於納入了質押成分，即基金參與網絡的權益證明共識機制以賺取獎勵，然後這些獎勵會反映在股票價值以及標的資產的價格表現中。

info.description: Exyn Technologies, Inc. is a robotics and artificial intelligence company developing autonomous mapping and navigation systems for complex, GPS-denied environments. The firm's proprietary technology enables aerial and ground robotic systems to navigate, map and collect real-time 3D data in environments where GPS, communications or prior maps may be unavailable or unreliable. The company was founded by Nader Elm and Vijay Kumar on May 12, 2014 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.

info.description_zh: Sensus Healthcare, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司，致力於為腫瘤和非腫瘤皮膚病提供治療。該公司由 Joseph C. Sardano、Richard Golin、Kalman Fishman 和 Stephen Cohen 於 2010 年 5 月 7 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Hadron Energy, Inc. is a nuclear technology company. It focuses on developing compact micro-modular nuclear reactors (MMRs) designed to provide continuous, carbon-free power for high-demand applications. The company was founded by Samuel Gibson in May 2024 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Hadron Energy, Inc.是一家核子技術公司。它專注於開發緊湊型微型模組化核反應器（MMR），旨在為高需求應用提供連續、無碳的電力。該公司由 Samuel Gibson 於 2024 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: MicroCloud Hologram, Inc. engages in research, development, and application of holographic technology. It operates through the Holographic Solutions and Holographic Technology Service segments. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: MicroCloud Hologram, Inc.從事全像技術的研究、開發與應用。它透過全息解決方案和全息技術服務部門運作。該公司成立於2020年，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Barinthus Biotherapeutics Plc is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of antigen-specific immunotherapeutics that induce T cells to treat chronic viral infections, autoimmune diseases, and cancer. It also focuses on the pipeline of both clinical and preclinical stage therapeutic, and prophylactic programs. The company was founded by Adrian Hill and Dame Sarah Gilbert in March 2021 and is headquartered in Didcot, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Barinthus Biotherapeutics Plc 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發抗原特異性免疫治療藥物，誘導 T 細胞治療慢性病毒感染、自體免疫疾病和癌症。它還專注於臨床和臨床前階段治療和預防計劃的管道。該公司由 Adrian Hill 和 Dame Sarah Gilbert 於 2021 年 3 月創立，總部位於英國迪德科特。

info.description: Datacentrex, Inc. is a digital infrastructure and capital deployment company. It engages in the owning and operating of Scrypt to compute assets and evaluate strategic transactions across asset-backed operating businesses. The company was founded by Robert Steele and Daniel Lupinelli on October 27, 2019 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.industry_zh: 財務數據和證券交易所
info.description_zh: Datacentrex, Inc. 是一家數位基礎架構和資本部署公司。它從事 Scrypt 的擁有和運營，以計算資產並評估資產支援營運業務的策略交易。該公司由 Robert Steele 和 Daniel Lupinelli 於 2019 年 10 月 27 日創立，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies for the treatment of solid tumors and other major diseases. Its product, Certepetide, is designed to activate a novel uptake pathway that allows co-administered or tethered anti-cancer drugs to target and penetrate tumors. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Basking Ridge, NJ.
info.description_zh: Lisata Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於治療實體瘤和其他重大疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化。其產品 Certepetide 旨在激活一種新型攝取途徑，使聯合給藥或聯合抗癌藥物能夠靶向並滲透腫瘤。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於新澤西州巴斯金里奇。

info.description: OceanPal, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of shipping transportation services. It also specializes in the ownership of vessels. The firm transports iron ore, coal and grains, and minor bulks such as bauxite, phosphate and fertilizers. The company was founded on April 15, 2021 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
info.description_zh: OceanPal, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供船舶運輸服務。它還專注於船舶的所有權。該公司運輸鐵礦石、煤炭和穀物，以及鋁土礦、磷酸鹽和化肥等小宗散裝貨物。該公司成立於2021年4月15日，總部位於希臘雅典。

info.description: AC Immune SA is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of therapeutic and diagnostic products for neurodegenerative diseases. It leverages proprietary technology platforms to discover, design, and develop novel, proprietary medicines for prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases associated with protein misfolding. The company was founded by Jean-Marie Lehn, Claude Nicolau, Roscoe Brady, Fred van Leuven, Ruth Greferath, Andrea Pfeifer, and Alexey V. Eliseev on February 13, 2003 and is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: AC Immune SA 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於神經退化性疾病治療和診斷產品的發現和開發。它利用專有技術平台來發現、設計和開發新穎的專有藥物，用於預防、診斷和治療與蛋白質錯誤折疊相關的神經退化性疾病。該公司由 Jean-Marie Lehn、Claude Nicolau、Roscoe Brady、Fred van Leuven、Ruth Greferath、Andrea Pfeifer 和 Alexey V. Eliseev 於 2003 年 2 月 13 日創立，總部位於瑞士洛桑。

info.description: Nicholas Bitcoin and Treasuries AfterDark ETF is an actively managed investment strategy designed to capture bitcoin's return profile specifically during U.S. overnight hours, from market close to the following market open. The fund maintains a dual-exposure structure, holding bitcoin-related instruments during the overnight session while rotating into short-term U.S. Treasuries and cash equivalents during U.S. daytime trading hours to potentially mitigate the volatility often associated with standard market sessions.
info.description_zh: Nicholas 比特幣與國債 AfterDark ETF 是一種主動管理的投資策略，旨在捕捉比特幣的回報情況，特別是在美國隔夜時段（從市場收盤到隨後的市場開盤）。該基金維持雙重曝險結構，在隔夜交易時段持有比特幣相關工具，同時在美國日間交易時段轉向短期美國國債和現金等價物，以潛在地減輕通常與標準市場交易時段相關的波動性。

info.description: BioVie, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovery, development, and marketing drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, and liver disease. The company was founded on April 10, 2013 and is headquartered in Carson City, NV.
info.description_zh: BioVie, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和行銷神經系統和神經退化性疾病以及肝病的藥物療法。該公司成立於2013年4月10日，總部位於內華達州卡森市。

info.description: Incannex Healthcare, Inc. is a biotech company, which engages in developing cannabinoid and psychedelic compound medicines. It focuses on the research and development for medicinal cannabis pharmaceutical products and psychedelic medicine therapies for treatment of a range of indications. The company was founded on April 27, 2001 and is headquartered in Norwest, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Incannex Healthcare, Inc.是一家生技公司，致力於開發大麻素和迷幻化合物藥物。它專注於藥用大麻藥物和用於治療一系列適應症的迷幻藥物療法的研究和開發。該公司成立於2001年4月27日，總部位於澳洲諾韋斯特。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Robinhood Markets, Inc. (Nasdaq: HOOD). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long HOOD ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Robinhood Markets, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：HOOD）每日股價變化百分比的兩倍（200%）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sale of precision fasteners, structural parts and other precision metal parts products. Its products include standard screws, nuts, bolts, turning parts, stamping parts and computer numerical control machining parts. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 中金康實業股份有限公司從事精密緊固件、結構件及其他精密金屬零件產品的製造及銷售。其產品包括標準螺絲、螺帽、螺栓、車削件、沖壓件和電腦數控加工件。公司成立於2011年，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long HOOD Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of HOOD. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 HOOD 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 HOOD 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 HOOD 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of HOOD. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of HOOD and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to HOOD, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily HOOD Bull 2X ETF 寻求每日投资结果（未计费用和开支）为 HOOD 每日业绩的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 HOOD 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些組合起來為 HOOD 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Robinhood Markets, Inc is a financial services platform, which engages in the provision of retail brokerage and offers trading in U.S. listed stocks and Exchange Traded Funds, related options, and cryptocurrency trading, as well as cash management, which includes debit cards services. The company was founded by Vladimir Tenev and Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt in 2013 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Robinhood Markets, Inc 是一家金融服務平台，從事提供零售經紀業務，並提供美國上市股票和交易所交易基金、相關選擇權、加密貨幣交易以及現金管理（包括金融卡服務）的交易。該公司由 Vladimir Tenev 和 Baiju Prafulkumar Bhatt 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州門洛帕克。

info.description: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a drug delivery technology company in Canada. It delivers drugs into body compartments, such as the joint without any of the common issues with body compartment injections, such as systemic exposure. The firm focuses on arthritis, diabetic macular edema, and chronic pain programs. The company was founded by James A. Helliwell, John Salvatore Montalbano and Amanda Malone on May 12, 2011 and is headquartered in Victoria, Canada.

It operates through the IT Services and Academic Education Services segments. The company was founded by Ming Hui Ling on August 30, 2005 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: CLPS, Inc.是一家控股公司，致力於為銀行、保險和金融業提供資訊科技、諮詢和解決方案服務。它透過 IT 服務和學術教育服務部門運作。該公司由明慧玲於2005年8月30日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Greenwich LifeSciences, Inc. engages in the development of a breast cancer immunotherapy designed to prevent the recurrence of breast cancer following surgery. The company was founded by Eric Rothe on August 29, 2006 and is headquartered in Stafford, TX.
info.description_zh: Greenwich LifeSciences, Inc. 致力於乳癌免疫療法的開發，旨在預防乳癌手術後復發。該公司由 Eric Rothe 於 2006 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州斯塔福德。

info.description: Sol Strategies, Inc. is an investment company. The firm is focused on the Solana ecosystem, which provides strategic investments and infrastructure solutions to enable decentralized finance. Its portfolio includes NGRAVE, Chia Network Inc., and zkSNACKS Limited. The company was founded on October 1, 2002 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Sol Strategies, Inc. 是一家投資公司。該公司專注於 Solana 生態系統，該生態系統提供策略性投資和基礎設施解決方案以實現去中心化金融。其投資組合包括 NGRAVE、Chia Network Inc. 和 zkSNACKS Limited。該公司成立於2002年10月1日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: QNB Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of commercial, retail banking, and retail brokerage services. The company was founded in 1877 and is headquartered in Quakertown, PA.

info.description: OTG Latin America ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation through investments in the equity securities of companies located in Latin America. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (including any borrowings for investment purposes) in Latin American equity securities. These equity securities include the securities of Latin American companies and investment companies that primarily invest in the securities of issuers in, or seek to track the performance of indices based on, Latin American markets. It may invest up to 20% of its assets in countries other than Latin American countries.
info.description_zh: OTG拉丁美洲ETF透過投資位於拉丁美洲的公司的股本證券尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於拉丁美洲股票證券。這些股本證券包括拉丁美洲公司和投資公司的證券，這些公司和投資公司主要投資於拉丁美洲市場發行人的證券，或尋求追蹤基於拉丁美洲市場的指數的表現。它可以將最多20%的資產投資於拉丁美洲國家以外的國家。

info.description: Social Commerce Partners Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 11, 2025 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Social Commerce Partners Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月11日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of public golf country clubs, namely Kissimmee Bay Country Club and Remington Golf Club. It operates through the following segments: Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental, Membership Dues, Food and Beverage Services, and Ancillary Services and Amenities. The Golf Recreation, Retail Golf Products, and Equipment and Facilities Rental segment is involved in the collection of fees for every round of eighteen holes, provision of driving ranges for practice, sale of golf apparel and equipment, and rental of golf products and cars. The Membership Dues segment refers to the membership fees for customers to access the club's facilities and services for a set period or daily at the point of sale. The Food and Beverage Services segment provides culinary services such as catering. The Ancillary Services and Amenities segment offers leisure activities hosted in an on-premises clubhouse, kitchen, bar, and dining area. The company was founded on December 22, 2023 and is headquartered in Kissimmee, FL.
info.description_zh: Aureus Greenway Holdings, Inc. 從事公共高爾夫鄉村俱樂部的所有權和運營，即基西米灣鄉村俱樂部和雷明頓高爾夫俱樂部。它透過以下部門運作：高爾夫娛樂部門、零售高爾夫產品部門、設備和設施租賃部門、會員費部門、餐飲服務部門以及輔助服務和便利設施部門。高爾夫娛樂、零售高爾夫產品以及設備和設施租賃分部涉及每輪十八洞收費、提供練習場、銷售高爾夫服裝和設備以及租賃高爾夫產品和汽車。會員費部分是指顧客在一定期限內或每天在銷售點使用俱樂部設施和服務所繳納的會員費。餐飲服務部門提供餐飲等烹飪服務。輔助服務和設施部分提供在內部俱樂部會所、廚房、酒吧和用餐區舉辦的休閒活動。該公司成立於2023年12月22日，總部位於佛羅裡達州基西米。

info.description: BTC Development Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 3, 2023 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: BTC Development Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年4月3日，總部位於賓州費城。

info.description: VanEck Digital Transformation ETF seeks to track as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS Global Digital Assets Equity Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities of Digital Transformation Companies. The index is a global index that tracks the performance of Digital Transformation Companies. The fund will not invest in digital assets (including cryptocurrencies) (i) directly or (ii) indirectly through the use of digital asset derivatives. info.description_zh: 創辦人主導的 2x 每日 ETF 是一款積極管理的基金，尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於創始人主導的指數每日表現的 200%。該策略針對一籃子美國最大的上市公司，其中至少有一名原始創辦人目前擔任關鍵的執行領導角色，利用每日槓桿來放大這些公司的價格變動。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long FIG Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of FIG. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of FIG, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund manager will attempt to achieve its investment objective without regard to overall market movement or the increase or decrease in the value of FIG. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍長期Fig 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為Fig 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，符合FIG 的價格，與基金的投資目標一致。基金管理人將嘗試實現其投資目標，而不考慮整體市場走勢或圖值的增加或減少。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GRI Bio, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for inflammatory, fibrotic, and autoimmune diseases. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 29, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Praetorian Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現與一個或多個企業的合併、聯合、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月29日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF is an actively managed strategy designed to generate real returns and provide a direct hedge against rising inflation while minimizing the interest rate volatility typically associated with long-duration inflation-protected securities. The fund invests primarily in a diversified portfolio of short-term U.S. Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) and inflation-linked derivatives, utilizing PIMCO's macroeconomic research to tactically manage inflation breakeven positioning and duration.
info.description_zh: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF 是一種主動管理策略，旨在產生實際回報並提供對通膨上升的直接對沖，同時最大限度地減少通常與長期通膨保值證券相關的利率波動。該基金主要投資於短期美國國債通膨保值證券（TIPS）和通膨掛鉤衍生性商品的多元化投資組合，利用太平洋投資管理公司的宏觀經濟研究來戰術性地管理通膨盈虧平衡頭寸和久期。

info.description: Scharf Global Opportunity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund primarily invests in U.S. and non-U.S. equity securities that the Adviser believes have significantly more appreciation potential than downside risk over the long term. Equity securities in which the fund may invest include, but are not limited to, common and preferred stock of companies of all size market capitalizations, rights and warrants. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 40% of its total assets in non-U.S. securities. During unusual market conditions, the fund will invest at least 30% of its total assets in non-U.S. securities.
info.description_zh: Scharf Global Opportunity ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於顧問認為長期來看升值潛力明顯大於下行風險的美國和非美國股票證券。本基金可投資的股本證券包括但不限於各種市值公司的普通股和優先股、權利和認股權證。一般情況下，該基金將至少40%的總資產投資於非美國證券。在異常市場條件下，該基金將至少將其總資產的 30% 投資於非美國證券。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2044 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2044 Maturity US Treasury Index. The fund seeks to meet its investment objective generally by investing in individual securities which satisfy the criteria of the index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2044 and December 15, 2044, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2044 Term Treasury ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 2044 年期美國公債指數的投資結果。該基金通常透過投資於滿足指數標準的個別證券來實現其投資目標。標的指數由公開發行的美國國債組成，計劃於 2044 年 1 月 1 日至 2044 年 12 月 15 日（含）之間到期。

info.description: Atlas Lithium Corp. operates as a U.S. mineral exploration and mining company with projects and properties in essentially all battery metals, including lithium, rare earths, graphite, nickel, cobalt, and titanium. The firm focuses on developing its hard-rock lithium project located in a premier pegmatitic district in Brazil Minas Gerais and Northeastern Brazil. Additionally, through subsidiaries, it participates in iron, gold, and quartzite projects and owns multiple mining concessions for gold, diamond, and industrial sand. The company was founded on December 15, 2011 and is headquartered in Minas Gerais,BR.
info.description_zh: Atlas Lithium Corp.是一家美國礦產勘探和採礦公司，擁有幾乎所有電池金屬的專案和財產，包括鋰、稀土、石墨、鎳、鈷和鈦。該公司專注於開發位於巴西米納斯吉拉斯州和巴西東北部首要偉晶岩地區的硬岩鋰計畫。此外，它還透過子公司參與鐵、金和石英岩項目，並擁有多個黃金、鑽石和工業砂的採礦特許權。該公司成立於2011年12月15日，總部位於巴西米納斯吉拉斯州。

info.description: Moody's Corp. engages in the provision of credit ratings, research, tools and analysis to the global capital markets. It operates through the Moody's Investors Service (MIS) and Moody's Analytics (MA) segments. The MIS segment is a credit rating agency, which publishes credit ratings on debt obligations and the entities, including various corporate and governmental obligations, structured finance securities, and commercial paper programs. The MA segment develops products and services, which support financial analysis and risk management activities of institutional participants in global financial markets. The company was founded by John Moody in 1909 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

info.description: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of specialty piping and leak detection systems. Its products include industrial and secondary containment piping systems for transporting chemicals, hazardous fluids and petroleum products, insulated and jacketed district heating and cooling piping systems for efficient energy distribution to multiple locations from central energy plants, and the coating and/or insulation of oil and gas gathering flow and long lines for oil or mineral transportation. The company was founded on October 12, 1993 and is headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.
info.description_zh: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. 從事特種管道和洩漏檢測系統的設計、製造和銷售。其產品包括用於運輸化學品、危險流體和石油產品的工業和二次安全殼管道系統、用於從中央能源工廠向多個地點高效分配能源的隔熱和夾套區域供熱和冷卻管道系統，以及用於石油或礦物運輸的油氣集流和長管線的塗層和/或隔熱。該公司成立於1993年10月12日，總部位於德克薩斯州伍德蘭茲。

info.description: Medalist Diversified, Inc. engages in the acquisition, reposition, renovation, lease, and management of income-producing properties. It focuses on commercial properties, including flex-industrial and retail properties, multi-family residential properties, and limited-service hotel properties. It operates through the following segments: Retail Center Properties, Flex Center Property and STNL Properties. The Retail Center Properties segment consists of the Shops at Franklin Square, the Ashley Plaza Shopping Center, the Lancer Center, and the Salisbury Marketplace Shopping Center. The Flex Center Property segment consists of Brookfield Center, the Greenbrier Business Center, and the Parkway property. The STNL Properties segment consists of the Citibank property, an outparcel at its Salisbury Marketplace property, and the Hanover Square outparcel. The company was founded on September 28, 2015 and is headquartered in Richmond, VA.
info.description_zh: Medalist Diversified, Inc. 從事創收財產的收購、重新定位、翻新、租賃和管理。它專注於商業房地產，包括靈活工業和零售房地產、多戶住宅房地產和有限服務酒店房地產。該公司透過以下部門營運：Retail Center Properties、Flex Center Property 和 STNL Properties。零售中心地產部門包括富蘭克林廣場商店、阿什利廣場購物中心、蘭瑟中心和索爾茲伯里市場購物中心。 Flex Center 物業部分包括 Brookfield Center、Greenbrier Business Center 和 Parkway 物業。 STNL 地產部門包括花旗銀行地產、索爾茲伯里市場地產和漢諾威廣場地產。該公司成立於2015年9月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州里士滿。
